data.name: Madihah
data.gender_notes: Madihah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'd-h-h', meaning 'to praise'. In Islamic tradition, Madihah refers to someone or something worthy of praise or glorification. This name is often given to a baby girl in the hope that she will grow up to be a source of admiration and respect. The name Madihah carries the meaning “Praiseworthy, Glorified” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Madihah usually hope their child will grow to embody praiseworthy, glorified and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Madihah total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
